name: Potential SentinelOne Shell Context Menu Scan Command Tampering
description: Detects potentially suspicious changes to the SentinelOne context menu scan command by a process other than SentinelOne.
author: GAI_CTI
query: registry.path:*\\shell\\SentinelOneScan\\command\\* AND (NOT (((winlog.event_data.Details:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\SentinelOne\\Sentinel\ Agent* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\SentinelOne\\Sentinel\ Agent*)) AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\SentinelScanFromContextMenu.exe*) OR (process.executable:(*C\:\\Program\ Files\\SentinelOne\\ OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\SentinelOne\\))))
